input.code:
def process(swarmA2014Load, swarmA2018Load) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    col = 'Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)'
    peak2014 = pd.to_numeric(swarmA2014Load[col], errors='coerce').max()
    peak2018 = pd.to_numeric(swarmA2018Load[col], errors='coerce').max()
    ratio = peak2014 / peak2018

    return pd.DataFrame([
        {
            'peak2014': peak2014,
            'peak2018': peak2018,
            'ratio': ratio,
            'ratioRounded2': round(ratio, 2),
        }
    ])
